P02_DQ_SENSITIVE_REPRESENTATION.bounded_claim: CBC_CAT2 and CBC_CAT3 are PASS for all 5345 frozen public target records. This is a public DQ state only and is not evidence that a candidate is true/false or noise-free.

P03_CALIBRATION_LIMITED_COVERAGE.bounded_claim: Public calibration-envelope coverage is available for 5174/5345 frozen records; missing coverage limits stronger calibration statements. No deterministic correction or PE propagation is performed.

P04_STRAIN_PRODUCT_SENSITIVITY_DESCRIPTI.bounded_claim: CALIB/NOLINES/CLEAN/GATED public products show descriptive differences in the frozen 23-identity/40-window cohort, but no Phase3 materiality threshold exists; therefore no confirmatory STRAIN_PRODUCT_SENSITIVE case is identified.

P05_FINAL_DEPENDENCY_CLASSIFICATION.bounded_claim: Final C7 candidate-detector classes are 35 PUBLIC_REPRESENTATION_SPECIFIC and 5 CALIBRATION_LIMITED. Classification boundary is stable across the executed preregistered robustness checks. No production-search effect is attributed.
